title: Frustratingly Easy Agentic RAG via Portable Skills: A Case Study in Customer Support
abstract: arXiv:2610.14428v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprise workflow automation typically requires retrieving a complete and accurate set of relevant information from large operational document corpora (SOPs, policy documents) given a specific scenario or request. In customer support (CS), for example, human specialists must determine the correct sequence of resolution steps for each case, a task that demands precise grounding in policy documentation. Meeting this bar in production typically requires complex document chunking, indexing, and retrieval pipelines, often layered with learned re-rankers, query rewriters, and bespoke agentic RAG infrastructure.   We report a deployment case study of a simpler alternative: a portable skill consisting of a natural-language instruction, lightweight tools (a retrieval API, format-checking scripts), and a corpus enriched with an LLM-generated navigation layer, which is a structured "Wikipedia-style" index over the underlying documents. translated_title: 通过可移植技能实现“简单得出奇”的智能体RAG：以客户支持为例的案例研究
translated_abstract: 企业工作流自动化通常需要在给定特定场景或请求的情况下，从大型运营文档语料库（标准作业程序、政策文档）中检索完整且准确的相关信息集合。例如在客户支持（CS）场景中，人类专家必须为每个案例确定正确的解决步骤顺序，这项任务要求对政策文档有精确的把握。在生产环境中达到这一标准通常需要复杂的文档分块、索引和检索流水线，并且往往还要叠加经过训练的重排序器、查询重写器以及定制的智能体RAG基础设施。我们报告了一项更简单的替代方案的部署案例研究：一种可移植技能，由自然语言指令、轻量级工具（检索API、格式检查脚本）以及通过LLM生成的导航层增强的语料库组成，该导航层是对底层文档进行结构化的“维基百科式”索引。该智能体……
tldr: 该论文的案例研究表明，仅由自然语言指令、轻量级工具和LLM生成的“维基百科式”导航索引组成的简单可移植技能，就能在客户支持场景中替代复杂的分块、检索与重排序流水线，实现有效的智能体RAG部署。
en_tdlr: A "frustratingly easy" portable skill—combining a natural-language instruction, lightweight tools, and an LLM-generated Wikipedia-style navigation index over documents—can replace complex chunking, retrieval, and re-ranking pipelines for agentic RAG in enterprise customer support.
